arguments.prompt:
Create one native pixel-art game animation SOURCE ATLAS of Hunter. FIXED INCARNATION: Spyro Reignited Trilogy (2018), Spyro: Year of the Dragon incarnation. APPEARANCE: Slim orange-yellow anthropomorphic cheetah Hunter with dark spots, long tail, pale muzzle and belly, athletic posture and brown quiver; complete practical bow.. EQUIPMENT AND ROLE: physical bow and arrows. SOURCE ACTION: Tir ajusté de Hunter. Hunter uses a bow in Year of the Dragon challenges. His own shot and athletic movement are retained; dragon fire is not transferred to him.

Detailed clean16-bit pixel art. Consistent three-quarter side view FACING RIGHT. EXACTLY48 COMPLETE INDEPENDENTLY DRAWN FIGURES, EIGHT COLUMNS and SIX ROWS (8x6). Every consecutive FOUR figures is a four-pose sequence. Every full head, native limbs, wings, tail and complete tool must remain inside its own cell. Draw slightly smaller bodies and GENEROUS TRANSPARENT GUTTERS with a32px outer margin. No overlapping figures, touching silhouettes, labels, text, numbers, grid, scenery, ground, shadows or watermark. Transparent background.

ROW1 columns1-4 INTRO: four different approaching/ready postures. Columns5-8 OUTRO: lower tools/hands, turn, depart, settle.
ROW2 columns1-4 ROUND VICTORY: four brief source-personality acknowledgments. Columns5-8 ROUND LOSS: four different disappointed/breathing/steady postures, completely unharmed.
ROW3 columns1-4 FINISHING PRESENTATION: Use the complete bow and one arrow: grip, draw the string, release the physical arrow locally in THIRD pose, recover. Every bow tip and string stay inside the cell. No rifle, fireball or magical bow. Columns5-8 MATCH VICTORY: four distinct celebrations DIFFERENT from the round-win group.
ROW4 columns1-4 MATCH LOSS: four different disappointed/crouched/recovering postures, unharmed. Columns5-8 SUPER: Use the complete bow and one arrow: grip, draw the string, release the physical arrow locally in THIRD pose, recover. Every bow tip and string stay inside the cell. No rifle, fireball or magical bow. Four NEW drawings, different from row3.
ROW5 columns1-4 IDLE: four different breathing/weight/wing/ear poses. Columns5-8 RUN: four actual alternating locomotion strides; flying or serpentine movement uses the real anatomy.
ROW6 columns1-4 ORDINARY ACTION: Four distinct postures for the named ordinary source action: Flèche de l’arc de Hunter. Prepare, aim or wind up, real source action in THIRD pose, recover. Keep the exact fixed anatomy and tool. No unrelated power or missing equipment. Columns5-8 HIT REACTION: four gentle flinch/steady/recover postures, complete and unharmed.

All48 are genuinely DIFFERENT DRAWINGS, never copied, shifted, mirrored, recoloured or padded duplicates. No attack or flash outside attack groups. No victim, blood, wounds, corpse, dismemberment or injury. Friendly solo game animation. These are original adapted drawings, not official game sprite frames.
